title: Community news gets a Build Diary
summary:
Community updates got a browsable diary, API errors got clearer, and Seed tier commit counts stopped caring about January 1.

The Community page’s static News section was replaced with an interactive timeline of PR analyses, daily summaries, and weekly digests. Readers can browse by date, open PR details, and view images made for different platforms. The page also shows more top contributors.

Upstream provider 429 responses are now returned as 502 across proxied text, image, and audio requests, while Enter’s own limits remain 429. Chat completion errors also extract readable messages from upstream JSON instead of leaving clients to parse the whole response.

Seed tier GitHub commit counts now use a rolling 90-day window rather than resetting with the calendar year. The tier explanation also reflects weekly evaluations and automatic upgrades.

daily.title: Browse the Build Diary
daily.text: Explore an interactive timeline of PR analyses, daily summaries, and weekly digests on the Community page. Open PR details and browse the images made for each update. [Visit the community site](https://pollinations.ai).
